about: PAR-INFRA-13: how each vanilla block of vanilla-shapes-<version>.json may serve as a hitbox carrier. presence: absent = never in a TFC world (usable as is); natural = occurs in TFC worlds (usable only with a one-hop hide mapping); player = players craft or place it in TFC (never usable); reserved = kept for another family; reference = dumped for comparison only. Every dumped block must be listed here or in hard_ban. replaceable_only: the states that are really replaceable when the dump's flag (BlockState.canBeReplaced(), the material flag) is wider: SnowLayerBlock lets any other item replace only layers=1 (a held snow layer adds a layer to any count below 8, see the snow notes in the item).

minecraft:snow.note: TFC snowfall places vanilla snow layers 1-8; real instances of a used layer count are sent as the nearest unused count

minecraft:white_carpet.note: wool carpets are crafted in TFC

minecraft:moss_carpet.note: kept as a vanilla item in TFC

minecraft:pale_moss_carpet.note: kept as a vanilla item in TFC

minecraft:stone_pressure_plate.note: kept for the rock pressure-plate family (freed sets)

minecraft:oak_pressure_plate.note: kept for the wood pressure-plate family (freed sets)

minecraft:light_weighted_pressure_plate.note: no gold or iron plates in TFC; unpressed 14x1x14, no collision

minecraft:stone_button.note: pair powered=false/true with one model (client press prediction)

minecraft:oak_button.note: pair powered=false/true with one model (client press prediction)

minecraft:cauldron.note: vanilla cauldron stays in the game

minecraft:candle.note: TFC has its own candles; lit states make particles

minecraft:sea_pickle.note: one box per pickle count; waterlogged states show water

minecraft:dirt_path.note: TFC uses its own path blocks

minecraft:pointed_dripstone.note: random XZ offset: rejected by the offset filter

minecraft:heavy_core.note: only in trial-chamber vaults (structures off), no recipe

minecraft:cobblestone_wall.note: lone post only; no vanilla structures or recipes in TFC worlds

minecraft:cactus.note: vanilla cactus never grows in TFC worlds; damage is server-side only

minecraft:smoker.note: lit states make particles and light

minecraft:oak_leaves.note: the CE leaves pool stands for every leaves state

hard_ban.minecraft:oak_trapdoor: the client predicts opening a wooden trapdoor

object_ban.reason: owner: reads as a group of separate pieces; allowed only for ground pieces

solid.note: CE auto_state solid pool (VisualAllocator's full-cube pass)
